# grouper_group_members (Resource)

Sets the immediate members of a Grouper group, removing anyone else. Members the group has only through nested groups aren't listed. Use one of these per group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grouper_group_members" "admins" {
  group    = grouper_group.admins.id
  subjects = { ldap = ["charlie", "lucy"] }
  groups   = [grouper_group.leads.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) UUID of the group, such as `grouper_group.example.id`.

### Optional

- `groups` (Set of String) UUIDs of groups nested in the group, whose members become members of this group too. Use this rather than `subjects` for groups.
- `subjects` (Map of Set of String) Subject IDs of people in the group, keyed by subject source, such as `{ ldap = ["charlie", "lucy"] }`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the group's current full name
tofu import grouper_group_members.admins org:dept:apps:admins
```
